Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5.1 for general availability and Claude Mythos 5.1 for restricted partners, featuring improved agentic workflows and a 75% reduction in API cache read pricing. Why it matters: The pricing adjustment significantly lowers the cost of running complex, multistep agentic tasks, potentially increasing the viability of AI-driven automation for enterprise workflows.
